items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Yeah, John Porter, Lewis Tillman, Celestan, and... Well, John Porter played bass and baritone. All right. In the same band, different times?

ctx.x: I see. Do you remember who was in that band, any of the people on that you heard?
Yeah, John Porter, Lewis Tillman, Celestan, and...
Excuse me, we better check and see what instruments they played, because some of them played two or three, you know? John Porter played...
